# no errors and no diagnostics

cd $WORK/example.com
exhaustive example.com/quux
stdout -count=1 ^$
stderr -count=1 ^$

# diagnostics

! exhaustive example.com/foo
stderr -count=2 ^.
stderr -count=1 ${/}'example.com'${/}'foo'${/}'foo.go:16:2: expression switch not exhaustive: missing cases: a\.AX0, a\.AX2$'
stderr -count=1 ${/}'example.com'${/}'foo'${/}'foo.go:26:2: expression switch not exhaustive: missing cases: VT1$'

! exhaustive example.com/bar
stderr -count=1 ^.
stderr -count=1 ${/}'example.com'${/}'bar'${/}'bar.go:11:2: expression switch not exhaustive: missing cases: d\.DX0'

! exhaustive -check=typeswitch example.com/foo
stderr -count=1 ^.
stderr -count=1 ${/}'example.com'${/}'foo'${/}'foo.go:38:2: type switch not exhaustive: missing cases: \*t, d\.DT1, \*d\.DT1'

# multiple package arguments

! exhaustive example.com/quux example.com/bar
stderr -count=1 ^.
stderr -count=1 ${/}'example.com'${/}'bar'${/}'bar.go:11:2: expression switch not exhaustive: missing cases: d\.DX0'

# flags

! exhaustive -p example.com/foo
stderr -count=1 ^.
stderr -count=1 ${/}'example.com'${/}'foo'${/}'foo.go:16:2: expression switch not exhaustive: missing cases: a\.AX0, a\.AX2$'

! exhaustive -typeignore='^example.com/a\.A1$' example.com/foo
stderr -count=1 ^.
stderr -count=1 ${/}'example.com'${/}'foo'${/}'foo.go:26:2: expression switch not exhaustive: missing cases: VT1$'

exhaustive -p -typeignore='^example.com/a\.A1$' example.com/foo
stdout -count=1 ^$
stderr -count=1 ^$

# errors

! exhaustive example.com/baz
stderr -count=1 ${/}'example.com'${/}'baz'${/}'baz.go:13:1: expected declaration, found xxxbuilderror$'
stderr '.+: analysis skipped due to errors in package'
stderr 'exhaustive: failed prerequisites: .+@example.com/baz'

! exhaustive .
stderr -count=1 '^-: no Go files in .+'${/}'example.com$'

! exhaustive example.net
stderr -count=1 '^-: no required module provides package example\.net;.+$'

mkdir empty
! exhaustive ./empty/...
stderr -count=1 'exhaustive: no packages matched$'

# note: parts of the txtar contents below were copied from
# passes/enumerated/testdata/*/depchain.
-- example.com/go.mod --
module example.com
go 1.26.0

-- example.com/foo/foo.go --
package foo

import "example.com/a"

func f1() {
	type T1 int

	const (
		VT0 T1 = iota
		VT1
	)

	var val1 a.A1
	var val2 T1

	switch val1 {
	case a.AX1:
	}

	switch val1 {
	case a.AX0:
	case a.AX1:
	case a.AX2:
	}

	switch val2 {
	case VT0:
	}
}

type i interface{ M() }

type t struct{}
func (t) M() {}

func f2() {
	var x i
	switch x.(type) {
	case t:
	}
}

-- example.com/bar/bar.go --
package bar

import "example.com/b"
import "example.com/c"

func f1() {
	var val1 c.C1
	var val2 int
	var val3 b.B2

	switch val1 {
	case c.CX1:
	}
	switch val2 {
	case b.BX0:
	}
	switch val3 {
	}
}

-- example.com/baz/baz.go --
package baz

import "example.com/a"

func f1() {
	var val1 a.A1

	switch val1 {
	case a.AX1:
	}
}

xxxbuilderror

-- example.com/quux/quux.go --
package quux

import "example.com/a"

func f1() {
	var val1 a.A1
	switch val1 {
	case a.AX0:
	case a.AX1:
	case a.AX2:
	}
}

-- example.com/a/file.go --
package a

import _ "example.com/b"
import _ "example.com/c"

type A1 int

const (
	AX0 A1 = iota
	AX1
	AX2
)

-- example.com/b/file.go --
package b

type B1 int

const (
	BY0 B1 = iota
	BY1
)

const (
	BX0 int = iota
	BX1
)

type B2 int

-- example.com/c/file.go --
package c

import "example.com/d"

type C1 = d.D1

const (
	CX0 = d.DX0
	CX1 = d.DX1
)

type C2 int

const (
	CY0 C2 = iota
	CY1
)

-- example.com/d/file.go --
package d

type D1 int

const (
	DX0 D1 = iota
	DX1
)

type D2 int

const (
	DZ0 D2 = iota
	DZ1
	DZ2
)

type DT1 struct{}
func (DT1) M() {}

-- example.com/e/file.go --
package e

type E1 int

const (
	EV0 E1 = iota
	EV1
	EV2
)
